catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.categoryIntro: Open a category to browse its items and today's net list prices.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.

lease.bandNote: Larger financed amounts get a lower rate, so your monthly rent can step up slightly when a higher down payment moves you below one of these limits.

contract.intro: Your agreement, payment plan and the story of your leased item — all in one place.
contract.priceLockBody: Your net rent was locked to price list {version} when you signed on {date}. The price cannot change later. VAT is recalculated for each invoice date, so the final total can change when tax changes.
contract.vatExplanation: Invoice 1 includes {amount} VAT at {rate}. VAT can change on a future invoice date, even though your net rent is locked.
contract.passportBody: Serial {serial} · life {life} of its circular journey.
contract.invoicesIntro: {count} monthly invoices, with VAT shown for each due date.
contract.noInvoices: The invoice schedule is not available yet.
contract.endIntro: When your term has ended and your rent is paid, choose what happens to the item next.
contract.returnBody: We assess the condition and prepare the item for its next life.
contract.buyBody: Keep it by paying the locked buyout of {amount} excl. VAT.
contract.passOnBody: Hand it straight to someone on the waiting list or a person you know.
leases.title: My leases
leases.intro: See what you have on lease, and decide what happens when a lease ends.
leases.choosePrompt: Choose a customer to see their leases.
leases.empty: There are no leases for this customer yet.
leases.readyNote: Your term has ended and your rent is paid. Choose what happens next.
secondLife.title: Second life
secondLife.intro: Returned items are refurbished here, then go back on lease at a new price based on their used value.
secondLife.empty: No returned items are waiting right now.
secondLife.unavailable: This item can't be refurbished yet.
contract.end.blocked.term_not_finished: You can choose from {date}, when your term ends.
contract.end.blocked.rent_balance_outsta: Pay the remaining {amount} of rent first, then choose.
contract.end.blocked.invoice_schedule_no: Your invoices have to be created before you can choose.
contract.end.blocked.contract_not_active: This lease is no longer active.
contract.end.returnSummary: Your lease ends now and the item comes back to us. We check it, fix it if needed, and lease it to someone new.
contract.end.buySummary: You pay the locked buyout and the item is yours. Your lease ends and no more rent is due.
contract.end.passOn.handoverIntro: Tell us how the item is today. It goes straight to the next person without a workshop visit, and this sets their price.
contract.end.passOn.price: {rent} a month excl. VAT for {term} months, based on a used value of {value}
contract.end.passOn.name: Their name
contract.end.passOn.noWaiting: Nobody on the waiting list matches this item right now.
contract.end.passOn.namedUnavailable: It can only go to someone you know if it is in at least good condition. You can return it instead.
contract.end.passOn.dataWipe: We include a certified data wipe before the handover, at no cost to you.
contract.end.passOn.contractNote: Your lease ends when you confirm, and you owe no buyout. The item is held for this person, who still has to apply and sign their own lease.
contract.end.passOn.done: Held for {who} at {rent} a month excl. VAT for {term} months.
contract.end.error: We could not complete that. Please check your details and try again.
